name: Code review kit
author: RdotA
description: Reviews, security checks, tests and error explanations for everyday coding.

prompts.title: Review a change
prompts.text:
Review this change like a careful senior engineer. List real problems first (bugs, edge cases, missing error handling), then smaller suggestions. For each, give the line or function and a concrete fix:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Security check
prompts.text: Check this code for security problems: injection, unsafe input handling, secrets, authentication and permission gaps, and unsafe defaults. Rank findings by severity and show how to fix each:

prompts.title: Explain this error
prompts.text:
Explain what this error means, the most likely causes in order, and how to confirm and fix each one:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Suggest tests
prompts.text: List the test cases this code needs (happy path, edge cases, failure modes), then write the most important ones using the project's test framework:

prompts.title: Make it faster
prompts.text: Find the slowest parts of this code and suggest improvements. Estimate the impact of each and keep behaviour identical:
